proposed_reference_answer_from_pending_d: The Faculty Manual 2020 extraction at page 13 lists faculty obligations including: treat teaching as a personal commitment; exemplify professional maturity and share instructional resources; respect learners and avoid ridicule; grade without personal friendship or vested-group pressure; meet individual student needs; keep confidential student information unless required by authorized agency or law; and share with parents the responsibility of shaping the student's future, including keeping parents informed of academic progress.
